summary: Targeted retest of the two fixes from iteration_3 on https://kitchen-staging-3.preview.emergentagent.com. Both fixes VERIFIED. (1) Manager RBAC route guards: qa-manager visiting /console/menu, /console/categories, /console/settings, /console/managers, /console/customers, /console/reports, /console/audit ALL redirect to /console (dashboard) — Guard component in StaffApp.jsx works. Allowed pages /console/orders, /console/deliveries, /console/live, /console/delivery-partners, /console/notifications all load normally for the manager. (2) Admin regression: all 13 sidebar destinations load normally for admin@cloudbite.com. (3) Customer OrderTracking not-found: /app/orders/000000000000000000000000 (404) and /app/orders/not-an-id (400) both render the tracking-not-found card with the tracking-not-found-back button navigating back to /app/orders — NO infinite Loading. (4) Real order CB1004 tracking still renders normally with tracking-stages, ORDER ARRIVED stage visible, and tracking-back returns to /app/orders. (5) Unauthenticated visit to /app/orders/<real-id> after clearing session correctly shows the customer login form (redirect to login, NOT the not-found card).

issues: Radix DialogContent aria-describedby warning still present from iteration_3 — cosmetic only, unchanged.

critical_code_review_comments: PASS — StaffApp.jsx Guard({perm,adminOnly}) wraps every non-index route (orders/menu/categories/customers/delivery-partners/managers/deliveries/live/reports/notifications/settings/audit); redirects unauthorised users to /console dashboard. Implementation is clean and consistent with useAuth().hasPerm.

PASS — OrderTracking.jsx uses a notFound state; load() .catch treats any non-401 status as not-found, clears the polling interval, and renders the tracking-not-found card. Correctly handles both 400 (invalid ObjectId) and 404 (foreign/nonexistent id). 401 is intentionally excluded so unauthenticated users still get redirected to login by the axios interceptor.

NIT — Guard reads user without null-checking; StaffApp already gates on user existence above (`if (!user...) return <StaffLogin />`), so this is safe but a defensive `user?.role` would be more robust if Guard is ever reused.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the two fixes and their regressions

context_for_next_testing_agent: Both iteration_3 bugs are FIXED and retested. Remaining known cosmetic issue: Radix DialogContent aria-describedby warning on customer FoodDetailSheet (a11y nit, non-blocking). Full end-to-end flows already validated in iteration_3.
